limitations.description: TLC model checking is finite-state assurance over the declared model constants; it is not an unbounded proof.

The alpha does not select transport, discovery, consensus or durability mechanisms; liveness is a separate optional profile that may be composed with Federation. Any terminal-resolution liveness remains conditional on the explicit target-local Seed progress assumption and does not transfer resolution ownership to Network or Federation.
Cryptographic algorithms, key custody and homomorphic-encryption profiles are not selected.
Partition classes, fork evidence and reconciliation are deferred to a separate coordination profile.

Exact behavioral refinement to the pinned SeedResolution.tla is mechanically proved by TLAPS for the declared Network-to-Seed abstraction mapping. The proof does not establish concrete Context-to-Authority or artifact-to-Binding identity construction beyond that mapping.
No independent third-party audit is bound to the exact alpha package digest.
